Summary Collaboration Themes: The collaboration between Maxim Raginsky and Talia Ringer bridges the gap between continuous-time dynamical systems/stochastic control and discrete formal verification/automated reasoning. Key themes include applying stability and controllability theories from neural ODEs/SDEs to ensure the robustness and correctness of LLM-based proof synthesis, using formal methods to verify the stability of neural control systems, and employing game-theoretic and risk-sensitive optimization frameworks to manage uncertainty and multi-agent interactions in automated verification and AI systems.
